const p="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboPaint 大 trajectory; run stages explicitly to preserve the single episode."""
+import json
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+Q = np.array([0., 1., 0., 0.])
+
+def pose():
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=[])
+    return np.asarray(o.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14], dtype=float)
+
+def move(points, dt=0.05, note='', video='none', cameras=None):
+    pts = np.asarray(points, dtype=np.float32)
+    if pts.ndim == 1:
+        pts = pts[None,:]
+    ans = r.submit('ee_pose', pts, dt=dt, note=note, video=video, cameras=cameras)
+    print(note, 'executed', ans.meta.get('executed_rows'), 'now', ans.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14], 'plan', ans.meta.get('plan'), flush=True)
+    return ans
+
+def line(a, b, n):
+    return np.linspace(np.asarray(a, dtype=float), np.asarray(b, dtype=float), n)
+
+def save_obs(tag, depth=False, cameras=None):
+    obs = r.get_obs(depth=depth, cameras=cameras)
+    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(f'/app/output/{tag}_{cam}.png')
+    for cam, d in obs.last_depth.items():
+        np.save(f'/app/output/{tag}_depth_{cam}.npy',d)
+    print(tag, obs.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14], r.status(), flush=True)
+    return obs
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    stage = sys.argv[1]
+    if stage == 'lift':
+        p = pose()
+        p1 = np.r_[p[:2], 0.23, Q]
+        move(line(p, p1, 15), note='lift dry brush')
+        move(np.repeat(p1[None,:], 20, axis=0), note='settle above paper')
+        save_obs('lifted', depth=True, cameras=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'])
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(p));
